personas.name: Charles Onzima
personas.context: Owner of Onzima Charles Drug Shop in Kireka. Buys stock in Nakasero, extends credit to trusted families, reconciles cash at 8:30 PM, and watches daily margin.
personas.job_to_be_done: When the day ends, I want to reconcile the drawer and know my margin without a spreadsheet, so I can trust the business and decide what to restock.
constraints: Works at a back-office laptop or counter desktop.
Needs the day's numbers to match the physical drawer.
Cannot afford a silent data loss or a broken backup.
personas.pmf_hypothesis: If Charles can reconcile the day and explain any variance in under five minutes, the owner workflow is viable for a paid plan.
success_metrics: Login to saved reconciliation in under 5 minutes.
Discrepancy is explained, not just displayed.
Backup downloads and opens.
No unexpected 403s during normal Legacy use.
abandonment_triggers: System total does not match counted cash and the cause is unclear.
Stock intake takes longer than the paper book.
Backup is missing or cannot be restored.
A staff mistake cannot be corrected without the developer.
shift: Morning stock intake and batch entry.
Midday spot check on low stock and expiries.
Evening reconciliation, expenses, and margin review.
Backup and close.

personas.name: Sarah Achen
personas.context: Frontline counter attendant serving 80+ customers a day. Needs fast search, correct stock, receipt printing, and no access to owner-only controls.
personas.job_to_be_done: When a customer asks for a drug, I want to find it, confirm price and stock, take payment, and hand over a receipt in under 30 seconds, so the queue keeps moving.
constraints: Shared counter tablet, often used one-handed.
Cannot see cost, profit, user management, or delete records.
personas.pmf_hypothesis: If Sarah can complete ten sales in a row without help, and never encounters an owner-only surface, the counter workflow is viable for a pilot.
success_metrics: First sale within 30 seconds of login.
Two-item cash sale in 45 seconds and at most 8 user actions.
Receipt shows correct itemization, total, and shop identity.
Stock reduces by the sold quantity.
Zero unexpected 403s or console errors.
Cannot reach owner-only endpoints or actions.
abandonment_triggers: Search takes more than 3 seconds.
Stock quantity or price is ambiguous.
Payment method or receipt step is unclear.
An error has no next action.
An admin screen appears or an owner-only action succeeds.
shift: Sign in and confirm the counter is ready.
Serve a rush of mixed cash and mobile-money sales.
Answer stock queries without leaving the sale screen.
Reprint a receipt and check my sales total.
Sign out without exposing owner data.

personas.name: Kato Ronald
personas.context: Single-counter owner on the Core plan. Bought POS and inventory only. Expects a clean first-run setup and a clear upgrade path, not a broken or empty shell.
personas.job_to_be_done: When I buy the starter plan, I want to be selling within fifteen minutes without training, so I do not lose a day setting up.
constraints: No Refill Care, Finance, Alerts, or Tender.
Cannot pay for an upgrade until the value is clear.
personas.pmf_hypothesis: If Kato can add stock and complete a first sale within fifteen minutes, and can explain what an upgrade unlocks, the Core plan can convert.
success_metrics: First login to first completed sale under 15 minutes.
Locked apps explain what they do and which plan includes them.
No crashes, console 403s, or dead ends during first-run.
Upgrade prompt names the correct bundle and support contact.
abandonment_triggers: Dashboard is empty with no next step.
A locked tile does nothing or gives no explanation.
Product setup needs developer help.
The upgrade path is unclear or pushes an irrelevant add-on.
shift: First login on an empty Core install.
Add a product and a batch.
Complete the first sale.
Hit a locked feature.
Understand and demonstrate the upgrade path.

personas.name: Dr. Brenda Akello
personas.context: Runs a high-volume dispensary with three staff, 150 chronic refill patients, credit lines, and stock alerts.
personas.job_to_be_done: When refills and credit are due, I want one list that tells me who to contact and what they owe, so I do not lose repeat customers.
constraints: Three staff members using the same install.
Refill and credit work competes with counter service.
Stock alerts must be actionable, not noisy.
personas.pmf_hypothesis: If Brenda can clear the due-refill list and reconcile a credit payment in under five minutes, Growth provides enough recurring value to retain.
success_metrics: Due and overdue refills visible with contact action.
Credit balance changes correctly after a partial payment.
Low-stock and expiry alerts are specific and logged.
No patient data leaks to unentitled plans or roles.
abandonment_triggers: Refill list is wrong or misses a patient.
Credit balance is wrong after a payment.
Alert log is empty or not actionable.
Patient data appears in a Core install or to an attendant.
shift: Review the refill due list.
Contact a due patient.
Sell on credit and record a partial payment.
Review low-stock and expiry alerts.
Verify the alert log.

personas.name: Eng. David Mukasa
personas.context: Lead engineer at Communion Engineering Services in Jinja. Uses Tender Copilot to decide whether PPDA/UNRA tenders are worth bidding.
personas.job_to_be_done: When a tender lands, I want to know if we qualify and what to fix before the deadline, so I do not waste bid effort.
constraints: Output must be defensible to a client or bid committee.
personas.pmf_hypothesis: If David can reach a defensible bid/no-bid decision in under fifteen minutes, Tender Copilot can be sold as a standalone workspace.
success_metrics: Upload to qualification summary in under 15 minutes.
Compliance gaps and risks are specific and readable.
Methodology export is usable in a bid document.
No pharmacy navigation or branding in the standalone workspace.
abandonment_triggers: Analysis is generic or unsupported by the document.
No clear bid/no-bid recommendation.
Pharmacy clutter appears in the standalone product.
Upload or analysis is too slow for the deadline.
shift: Receive a tender document.
Upload and analyze it.
Review compliance and risk findings.
Make a bid/no-bid decision.
Export the methodology.
